Master craftspeople and culture keepers who lend their guild hands to allies they admire, asking only that beauty gets protected. Cute, but serious.

Interstellar alliance of spacefaring civs bound by strict non-interference. Hard to befriend and even harder to make mad.
Antimatter corsairs who strip dead stars and weaker empires alike. They take what they want, and only overwhelming respect keeps their fleets off you.
Beings who exist across multiple dimensions, and they see your civ as a fun little curiosity. Indifferent by nature, but their favor bends reality.
